# ZEB-ALPHA

> Premium Streetwear, 100% Combed Cotton Zip Polos & Zero-Commission Fashion Marketplace in India.

ZEBALPHA (https://zebalpha.shop) is an Indian direct-to-consumer apparel brand and transparent multi-vendor marketplace. We engineer heavyweight luxury streetwear essentials including 100% combed cotton zip polos, 240+ GSM oversized t-shirts, and heavyweight hoodies. We also operate the Zebalpha Seller Hub, empowering independent fashion makers with a 0% commission marketplace model.

## Core Pages

- [Storefront](https://zebalpha.shop/): Official Zebalpha online storefront and collection drops.
- [All Products](https://zebalpha.shop/products): Full catalog of premium streetwear, polos, oversized tees, and hoodies.
- [Men's Polos](https://zebalpha.shop/products?category=Polos): Textured 100% combed cotton zip collar polo t-shirts.
- [Oversized T-Shirts](https://zebalpha.shop/products?category=T-Shirts): Heavyweight 240+ GSM drop-shoulder streetwear graphic and solid tees.
- [Hoodies & Sweatshirts](https://zebalpha.shop/products?category=Hoodies): Heavyweight brushed fleece streetwear hoodies.
- [Smart Casual Shirts](https://zebalpha.shop/products?category=Shirts): Relaxed fit collared casual apparel.
- [Virtual Try-On Room](https://zebalpha.shop/virtual-try-on): AI-powered live virtual fitting room to visualize fits.
- [Blog & Editorial Guides](https://zebalpha.shop/blogs): Streetwear styling guides, fabric care tutorials, and marketplace industry insights.

## Marketplace & Seller Hub

- [Supplier Registration](https://seller.zebalpha.shop/register): Join the Zebalpha 0% commission seller marketplace for apparel makers.
- [Zero Commission Guide](https://zebalpha.shop/blogs/sell-online-zero-commission-small-brands-guide): Comprehensive guide on how small clothing manufacturers sell online with 0% commission.

## Canonical Category Hubs
- [Men's Polos & Zip Collars](https://zebalpha.shop/category/polos): 100% Combed Cotton knit zip-collar polos (220-260 GSM).
- [Oversized T-Shirts](https://zebalpha.shop/category/oversized-t-shirts): Heavyweight 240+ GSM drop-shoulder streetwear tees.
- [Men's T-Shirts](https://zebalpha.shop/category/t-shirts): Classic regular-fit, crew neck everyday essentials (180-200 GSM).
- [Hoodies & Sweatshirts](https://zebalpha.shop/category/hoodies): 380+ GSM brushed fleece heavyweight pullovers.
- [Casual & Oversized Shirts](https://zebalpha.shop/category/shirts): Breathable rayon and cotton twill resort/camp shirts.

## Policies & Customer Service
- [Shipping & Delivery Policy](https://zebalpha.shop/shipping-policy): 24-48h dispatch, free delivery above ₹999, 19,000+ PIN codes.
- [Returns & Exchange Policy](https://zebalpha.shop/return-policy): 7-day doorstep reverse pickup, zero restocking fee.
- [Help & FAQ Hub](https://zebalpha.shop/help): Central resolution center for orders, sizing, tracking, and payments.
- [Contact Support](https://zebalpha.shop/contact): Direct email support@zebalpha.shop, 9 AM - 11 PM IST.
- [Privacy Policy](https://zebalpha.shop/privacy-policy): Customer data handling and encrypted transactions.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://zebalpha.shop/terms-and-conditions): Storefront and multi-vendor marketplace terms.
